__doc__: Optional. Copy to floorplans.json to draw real floor plans over the map.
Neither OpenStreetMap nor the Gen Con event database publishes interior
plans for these buildings, so the app draws schematic interiors instead.
If you have plan images — from Gen Con, from a venue's own website, or
photographed from the printed programme — put them in public/floorplans/
and list them here. They are read at runtime, so adding one to a deployed
site means uploading two files, not rebuilding.
Keys are venue ids from src/data/venues.ts. 'level' must match a Room.level
on that venue, so selecting a room shows the plan for the floor it is on.
Each plan is stretched to its venue's real OSM footprint bounds, so how
well it lines up depends on the image being cropped to the building.
These are somebody else's drawings: set 'credit', and check you are allowed
to redistribute an image before publishing it on a public site.
